findings.description: F-007: the callout claimed chapter 19's snake is driven by .bind(); chapter 19 uses turtle screen.listen()/onkeypress() and says so explicitly.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the callout in build_01() to mirror 19.4's own framing: the same idea of binding a key to a function returns in chapter 19, but via Turtle's simpler screen.listen()/screen.onkeypress() interface. Verified: grep for 'screen.onkeypress' in build_chapter_17.py returns 1, and no .bind() claim about chapter 19 remains.
